map.由剪应力与 G 求剪应变: Shear strain from shear stress and G
map.gamma = tau / G。剪应力 tau=10MPa、G=77GPa 时: gamma = tau / G. With shear stress tau = 10 MPa and G = 77 GPa, gamma ≈ 1.3e-4 (radian). Shear strain is a dimensionless angular deformation.
map.小变形时 gamma≈tan(φ)≈φ（弧度），是直角的改变量。: For small deformation gamma ≈ tan(φ) ≈ φ (radian), the change in a right angle.
map.剪应变单位？: What are the units of shear strain?
map.无量纲（弧度，因是长度比长度）。工程上直接以弧度表示直角变化。: Dimensionless (radian, since it is length over length). In engineering the right-angle change is expressed directly in radians.
map.剪应变和正应变区别？: What is the difference between shear strain and normal strain?
map.正应变是伸缩（长度变化率），剪应变是角度畸变（直角改变）；分别对应法向与切向载荷: Normal strain is extension (rate of length change) while shear strain is angular distortion (right-angle change); they correspond to normal and tangential loading respectively.
